The '''Corellian Guard''' was a military unit within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that the Rebel operative [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Yanus Melikan]] served in during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
